result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your blood pressure was high at the surgery. It was measured on 25 September 2026. The reading was 168/98.
The surgery wants to check it again. No decisions will be made until your blood pressure has been checked again.

## What you need to do
1. Use the machine in the surgery waiting room. Measure your blood pressure once a week for 4 weeks.
2. Give your readings to reception.
3. Go to your nurse appointment on 29 October 2026.
4. Do not expect any decisions before the new checks are done.

## Dates and medicines
- 25 September 2026: your blood pressure was measured at the surgery. It was 168/98.
- Thursday 29 October 2026 at 09:30: your next appointment with the practice nurse.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What should I do if I forget a weekly check?
- How will you use my readings?
- What will happen at my nurse appointment?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
